angles: Steelers (2-1) at Browns (2-1), 8:15 PM ET. Sharp market: Pittsburgh about 58% to win (Pinnacle 58.0%, Kalshi 57.5%), total 38.5 with the under a slight favorite.
DraftKings' prices tonight are all at or worse than the sharp fair price -- every main line and every prop we could compare at the same number. That's a Pass.

Injuries (final report): PIT -- RB Rico Dowdle and CB Joey Porter Jr. OUT, CBs Jalen Ramsey and Brandin Echols questionable. CLE -- WR Tylan Wallace, G Teven Jenkins, C Elgton Jenkins OUT (two interior linemen down).
Weather: about 70 degrees, cloudy, wind near 10 mph, small chance of rain (Covers).
Props where DK's number differs from Pinnacle's (Rodgers 215.5 vs 214.5 pass yards, Watson 186.5 vs 185.5, Fannin 40.5 vs 38.5 receiving yards) aren't compared -- different lines aren't the same bet.

No Fun Parlay: the only DK-priced leg we read that's 55%+ is the Steelers moneyline, and it's priced worse than fair. Two legs at 55%+ weren't available, so the $0.25 stays in your pocket and rolls to Saturday-Monday.

easy_bet.plain_summary: Nothing on DraftKings tonight is priced better than the sharp books. Skip Thursday -- the money carries to the weekend.

Same-line props (Warren/Judkins rushing, Metcalf receiving) all -1% to -5%. Retail color (not used as probability): Covers lists the game PIT 57% / CLE 43%.
